purpose: Consolidate the already frozen C-PHYS-M1 model functions, differential operator, pole-regular function space, topology/orientation conventions and eight independent cap/global residuals into one unambiguous ULSH-01 WP1 solver-facing target-and-boundary contract without creating or authorizing a physical background solve.
source_precedence: Later append-only correction contracts override only the fields they explicitly correct.
Background3ATopologyCorrection v0.2 replaces the obsolete regional five-integer topological input by (N_F,N_sigma,m_sigma).
Background3AAssemblyCorrection v0.3 requires all eight regularized regional bulk residuals at every Lobatto node and appends eight boundary/global residuals.
The August 5 authorization denial remains operative: control-path success does not authorize the a_F=1/4 physical target path.

postulates_and_model_selection: 6D Einstein-scalar-Maxwell bulk action plus one common localized cap phase sector.
C-PHYS-M1 exact function family is a versioned candidate-model selection, not a derivation from Hyperzeit first principles.
Delta_chi=2*pi, regular pole gauges, charge lattice and two-region orientation are frozen conventions.
theory_skeleton.dynamics: Two regional copies of the exact M1 bulk ODE system E_A=E_ell=E_varphi=E_gauge=0, with C_rr as propagated QA constraint, joined by eight independent cap/global residuals.
theory_skeleton.observables: WP1 defines no physical observable and no 6D->4D forward map; outputs are formal residual channels, traces, dimensions and gate states only.
tests_and_falsification: Algebraic mismatch with any canonical dependency falsifies this consolidated contract and requires append-only correction before WP2.
Failure of pole regularization, residual count, orientation consistency or dimensionless-unit checks blocks WP2.
Future numerical root/convergence can test implementation consistency but cannot by itself prove continuum existence, uniqueness, stability or physical identification.

field_and_unit_contract.unit_check: Every frozen bulk and boundary residual in this contract is dimensionless after the declared rescaling.

local_radial_coordinates.x_N: increases from north smooth pole to common cap
local_radial_coordinates.x_S: increases from south smooth pole to common cap

pole_regular_boundary_contract.frame_rule: A_N(0)=0 removes the additive warp redundancy; A_S(0) remains an augmented unknown.
pole_regular_boundary_contract.regular_singular_statement: The principal determinant is 4*ell; the interior is full rank for ell>0 and the poles are regular singular. The parity-factorized tau chart is part of the domain definition, not optional initialization advice.

bulk_target_equation_contract.bulk_enforcement: All eight regularized regional bulk residual blocks are enforced at every collocation node, including continuous tau=0 pole extensions and tau=1 cap endpoints; no bulk row is replaced by a boundary row.

cap_trace_definitions.continuity_common_cap: The induced A, ell and varphi are common at the cap; a_chi is related by the frozen U(1) patch transition.
cap_trace_definitions.a_chi_Sigma: a_chi_N(rho_N) in the north cap chart used for the localized winding residuals; the south chart is related by R_patch

not_additional_independent_residuals.R_flux: Equivalent to R_patch under the frozen regular gauges, transition function and oriented two-form convention; count exactly once.
not_additional_independent_residuals.C_rr_N_and_C_rr_S: Propagated QA channels, not endpoint residuals.
not_additional_independent_residuals.phase_equation: Automatic for the static homogeneous winding ansatz.

operator_function_space_contract.physical_solution_set: G^{-1}(0) is not shown to be nonempty
operator_function_space_contract.linearized_trace: D_B[W_star] is admissible for numerical rank evaluation only after a separately frozen candidate W_star satisfying G(W_star)=0 with provenance and tolerances.

a_F_to_zero.limit: Z_F->1 and the explicit scalar-flux source 2*a_F*ell*rho_F in E_varphi vanishes
a_F_to_zero.inference_limit: Control limit does not establish identity with C1-V or a physical target background.

mhat_phi_sq_to_zero.risk: long-range or shift-like scalar behavior and loss of heavy-scalar control

k4_to_zero.admissibility: No existence claim follows; whether a regular global solution exists is a separate BVP question.

weak_flux.caveat: q_s cannot be varied independently of the fixed topological/patch sector in a physical run without a new declared run/model instance.

strong_curvature.criterion: |k4|*exp(-2*A) comparable to or larger than |Lambda_hat|, rho_F and scalar-potential terms
strong_curvature.caveat: No asymptotic branch is claimed without solving the global regular BVP.

must_hold_before_wp2: All dependency paths resolve on the reviewed repository state.
Exact bulk residual strings and residual order match the canonical M1 operator.
Pole chart enforces Delta_chi=2*pi smooth-pole parity and A_N(0)=0 frame normalization.
Discrete sector is exactly (N_F,N_sigma,m_sigma); forbidden regional duplicate winding/charge labels are absent.
Boundary/global residual vector has exactly eight independent components and R_flux is not double counted.
C_rr is retained only as a QA channel.
All active M1 parameter-domain conditions remain strict.
No target-solve authorization is encoded in WP1.

wp2_handoff.title: Make the physical BVP transaction release-ready against the frozen target payload
must_bind: this WP1 contract and its repository blob/commit identity
the frozen CP01R1 payload without parameter or topology mutation
source-bound physical target entry point that refuses a_F=0 control override
resource policy, dependency lock and result schema
single-use authorization grant semantics with nonce, validity window, atomic consumption, replay rejection and crash recovery

forbidden_inferences: Formal closure of WP1 is not a physical background solution.
A square BVP count is not a proof of trace-map invertibility or uniqueness.
Analytic a_F=0 backend controls are not evidence for the a_F=1/4 target.
Numerical stability or residual convergence, when later obtained, is not ghost freedom.
No K1-D or K1-E transition follows from this contract.
No claim is made that the M1 function family is derived uniquely from the 6D Hyperzeit sector.
